archetypes.name: quorum-reaper
archetypes.rationale: The reaper rewrite changes process lifecycle and fallback eligibility.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the quorum math, deadline arming, and filtered collection mapping. Verify that straggler-dropped slots cannot enter phase2 or phase3. Pay close attention to no-quorum, fast-failure, and floor/ceiling cases. Cite the plan section and file path for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: panel-scope-guard
archetypes.rationale: The cutoff must affect reviewer panels without changing voters, decompose, or aggregation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the opt-in flag placement across caller surfaces. Confirm plan-review and code-review panels pass the flag, while voting, decompose, and aggregation do not. Flag any accidental global behavior changes. Cite the plan section and file path for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
